SELECT id, report_uid AS "reportUid", job_id AS "jobId", device_id AS "deviceId", source_kind AS "sourceKind", source_detail AS "sourceDetail", status, job_status AS "jobStatus", payload, created_by AS "createdBy", created_at AS "createdAt" FROM twin_diff_report WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}
